name: nircmd
description: Multi-purpose command-line utility for Windows system administration and automation

nircmd.description: Comprehensive command-line tool for Windows operations like window management, system control, and registry manipulation
nircmd.usage:
nircmd win hide title "Calculator"
nircmd setvolume 0.8
nircmd cdrom open
nircmd monitor off
nircmd exitwin shutdown

nircmdc.description: Console version of NirCmd with enhanced output and scripting capabilities
nircmdc.usage:
nircmdc win max process "notepad.exe"
nircmdc setdefaultsounddevice "Speakers"
nircmdc exec show "C:\Program Files"
nircmdc killprocess "process.exe"
